findings.title: SQL injection via string concatenation
findings.message: Tainted input is concatenated into a SQL string passed to query/execute.
findings.remediation: SQL injection via string concatenation. See https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/89.html

findings.message: Tainted input reaches a shell command (exec/execSync/spawn with shell: true).

findings.title: Open redirect
findings.message: Tainted input is passed to res.redirect.

findings.title: Dockerfile runs as root
findings.message: No USER instruction; the container defaults to root.

findings.title: Express app does not use helmet
findings.message: An Express app is created but helmet() is never applied.
findings.remediation: Add app.use(helmet()) to set standard security headers.

findings.title: Auth route without a rate limiter
findings.message: Route /login looks like an auth endpoint and has no rate limiter.
findings.remediation: Apply express-rate-limit (or similar) to login/auth routes.
